name: shark-plugins
description: Shark Software's team marketplace of Claude Code plugins: skills, agents, hooks and MCP configurations.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Read-only architecture-reviewer agent that checks a diff or module against the project's layer boundaries and returns evidence-backed findings with a PASS/BLOCK verdict.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared engineering skills for TypeScript web projects: onion backend layering, frontend architecture, React, Next.js, Fastify, Zod, TypeScript, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, OWASP security, Mermaid and a project insights log.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent that answers repo and external questions with cited evidence and an explicit list of what it could not establish.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec Driven Development: spec → plan → implement → verify with user gates, plus a per-plan workflow retro.

plugins.name: security-review
plugins.description: Read-only security-reviewer agent and appsec-review skill that trace untrusted data from source to sink and return evidence-backed findings with a PASS/BLOCK verdict.
